message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on country of origin (Morocco vs. Spain) for frozen octopus. The classification is HTSUS 0307.52 (octopus, frozen), under heading 0307 for molluscs. Subheading 0307.5 covers octopus (Octopus spp.): 0307.51 is live, fresh or chilled, and 0307.52 is frozen. Within 0307.52 the statistical suffixes are 0307.52.10 (smoked) and 0307.52.20 (other). I recall the 8-digit as 0307.52.00 for frozen octopus, so I checked the 2022 HTS: 0307.51.00 Live, fresh or chilled; 0307.52.00 Frozen; 0307.59 Other. The 10-digit statistical suffixes in 0307.52.00 are probably 0307.52.0000, but I am not certain. The 2022 schedule lists 0307.51.0000 as live/fresh/chilled and 0307.52.0000 as frozen, so I will use the latter.
